parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/WallpaperSampleApp path — a clear sample-app context. Per the decision rules, any cluster containing a sample-app record must default to no-action, because lifting the production DebugPanel type-alias into shared code would couple production semantics to demonstration code.
